draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.20, the 92nd-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 7th of 18 at S. He went 64th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (92nd): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 69 tackles in 2024, 13th of 18 Ss in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 2 pro, currently with the Philadelphia Eagles. 11 career games and 10 starts over 1 completed season, plus 4 so far in 2026. Still developing: 3 AV in 2025. Strengths in 2025: interceptions 2 (76th percentile). Weak spots: passer rating allowed 113.0 (23rd percentile). Played 11 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-1 safety who played: 59.7% season snap share against a median of 24.1%, above the norm.
